title: A Syndrome-Extraction Framework for Distributed Lattice Surgery on Arbitrary Rotated Surface-Code Layouts
summary: Modular quantum computing is a leading candidate for scalable fault tolerant quantum computation. Performing lattice surgery using surface code patches in different modules requires the use of inter-module gates that are noisier than the local gates. Furthermore, the merged layouts during lattice surgery expose multiple directions in which hook errors can propagate to reduce the fault distance.
